subject: API sunsetting runway, comms ladder and exception triage
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: API sunsetting runway, comms ladder and exception triage

Team —

We need to lock down three things this week for the planned API sunset (target cutover: 2027-03-31): the external comms runway, the exception ladder (who reviews and what qualifies), and PMO triage cadence for high-risk accounts. Product wants a firm deprecation date to include in the public notice, but we need to be confident we can ship mitigations and offer exceptions on a controlled basis.

Proposed immediate asks: 
- Aditya: consolidate the high-risk account list (>= $50k ARR or regulated). I don't need PII, just account names + reason.
- Lauren: draft the customer-facing comms cadence (initial notice, technical notice, migration reminder, final cutoff). Include recommended subject lines and channel mix (email, console banner, account reps).
- Marcus: confirm the compliance/security must-haves for exceptions (audit trail, SLA changes, data residency hoops).

I've attached a rough exceptions matrix and a skeleton comms draft to iterate off. Please reply with owners/ETA by EOD Tuesday (2027-01-12). If we can't commit to a 03/31 cutover, call it out in your reply and propose an adjusted runway.

Attachments referenced: [exceptions_matrix.xlsx], [customer_comm_draft.md]

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: API sunsetting runway, comms ladder and exception triage

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick clarifications: 
1) I can produce the high-risk account rollup by Tuesday, but I need a quick filter: do we treat contractual-enterprise accounts with multi-year terms as automatically exception-eligible, or do we want to triage them individually?
2) For the target cutover 03/31: is that a hard deadline for hosted customers only or for Dedicated/Private customers as well? That affects the outreach wording.

I'll start pulling the list and will flag any accounts that require legal or SalesOps review. ETA: 2027-01-12 16:00 PST.

—Aditya
Staff Product Manager

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: API sunsetting runway, comms ladder and exception triage

Kimberly / Aditya —

I've sketched a comms runway that maps to your proposed timeline. High level: 
- T-minus 8 weeks (2027-02-03): Public notice + support KB with migration guide; notify account reps for named customers.
- T-minus 6 weeks (2027-02-17): Technical migration notice to engineers (payload changes, sample code). Console banner added.
- T-minus 3 weeks (2027-03-10): Reminder + migration office hours (weekly). Offer hands-on sessions for top 10 accounts.
- T-minus 0 (2027-03-31): Final cutoff + post-cutover FAQ + escalation path.

Channel mix suggestions: email (segmented), console banner, scheduled webinars, and targeted AM/CS outreach for enterprise. For subject lines: keep it specific and action-driven (e.g., "Action required: Migration from legacy /v1 endpoints by 3/31/27").

Exception ladder idea: 
- Level 1 (Sales/AM): short-term extension up to 30 days (auto-approved for contracts in-flight).
- Level 2 (Product + Security): up to 90 days with mitigation plan.
- Level 3 (Leadership + Legal): >90 days or policy exemptions.

I'll post the draft comms doc to the shared Drive and include suggested copy for each email. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sunset-comm-template

Lauren
VP, Growth & Customer Communications

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: API sunsetting runway, comms ladder and exception triage

Kim / team —

Couple of critical security/compliance points for the exceptions ladder: 
1) Any exception that changes data residency or increases token retention needs a documented mitigation and a timestamped audit trail. We must be able to show approvals tied to a ticket (no ad-hoc Slack signoffs).
2) For regulated customers (health/finance), we require a short technical mitigation plan (what we'll provide while the customer migrates) and a named owner.
3) Logging: requests and fallback metrics must be retained for 180 days for any exception >30 days.

I've attached an exceptions_matrix.xlsx that maps example scenarios to approvers and required evidence — use it as the working template. For Sales: please produce a contact/outreach list so we can route approvals faster (I don't want to chase AMs for escalation paperwork).

Attachment: [exceptions_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

—Marcus
Head of Security & Compliance

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Bcc: Caroline Vega <caroline.vega@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: API sunsetting runway, comms ladder and exception triage — decisions and owners

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Summary and owners (we'll treat this as the source of truth):
- Cutover date: 2027-03-31 (hosted + dedicated); private/on-prem customers will be handled case-by-case and flagged in the exceptions matrix.
- High-risk account rollup: Aditya to deliver CSV by close of day 2027-01-12 (received; flagged 18 accounts; forwarded to Lauren).
- Comms runway: Lauren to finalize email copy + console banners by 2027-01-18 and publish to Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sunset-comm-template).
- Exception ladder: Marcus to own policy checklist and ensure audit trail requirements are operational; Security will require ticketed approvals and 180-day logging for exceptions >30 days.
- PMO triage: I'll schedule a weekly 30-min triage starting 2027-01-19 (Wednesdays 9am PST). Marcus/Aditya/Lauren to attend the first three meetings.

Next steps for Sales/AM: please compile the outreach list for the 18 flagged accounts; attach contact names and AM owner to the exceptions_matrix.xlsx and drop in the Drive folder.

I'll draft an exec summary for leadership to sign-off on Friday. If any team cannot meet the ETA, flag now.

Cheers —
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
